caption: Twelve notes about books, papers and manuals in one base. Each card shows page 1 of the PDF that the note links to, with the author and the year.
eval: await (async () => { app.workspace.rightSplit.collapse(); app.plugins.plugins['pdf-cover-cards'].pro.signOut(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800)); await app.plugins.plugins['pdf-cover-cards'].targetView()?.fillAll(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600)); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Bread at Home has no PDF property. It embeds its PDF in the text, so its card uses that PDF.
eval: await (async () => { app.plugins.plugins['pdf-cover-cards'].pro.signOut(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); const leaf = app.workspace.getLeaf('split', 'vertical'); await leaf.openFile(app.vault.getFileByPath('PDF Cover Cards/Bread at Home.md')); window.__pccLeaf = leaf; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 900)); for (const v of app.plugins.plugins['pdf-cover-cards'].views) await v.fillAll(); const c = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pdf-cover-card')].find((x) => x.dataset.path.endsWith('Bread at Home.md')); c && c.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Each card with a PDF has an Open at page button under its properties.
eval: await (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['pdf-cover-cards']; p.pro.signOut(); const end = Date.now() + 10000; while (Date.now() < end) { const v = p.targetView(); if (v?.cards.length === 12) { await v.fillAll(); const images = [...v.containerEl.querySelectorAll('.pdf-cover-card-cover img')]; if (v.cards.every((c) => c.status === 'drawn') && images.length === 12) { await Promise.all(images.map((img) => img.decode())); v.containerEl.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'instant' }); await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame); return 'ok'; } } await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 50)); } throw new Error('PDF covers were not ready for the screenshot'); })()

caption: Preview page 2 of a PDF on its card. The open button follows the preview.
eval: await (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['pdf-cover-cards']; p.pro.signOut(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); const v = p.targetView(); await v.fillAll(); const c = v.cards.find(c => c.pages > 1 && c.status === 'drawn'); if (!c) throw new Error('No multi-page PDF card'); await v.changePage(c, 1); if (c.choice.page !== 2) throw new Error('Preview did not reach page 2'); c.coverEl.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); return 'ok'; })()
